pkgmetadata.longdescription: Playwright automates Chromium, Firefox and WebKit browsers with a single API. This is the upstream Node.js package from the npm registry: it installs the "playwright" command line tool and the JavaScript/TypeScript library (playwright plus playwright-core) under Node.js, and it is the reference implementation the language bindings are built on. Only JavaScript, a WASM image codec and data files are installed, so nothing here is architecture specific. The browser binaries themselves are not part of the package: they are downloaded at runtime with "playwright install".
